messages:
emily: Heads up — final social push for the launch webinar next Wed. Need LinkedIn + X copy, hero image, and the seedlist routing plan by EOD tomorrow. Can we lock down captions and times?

jordan: I can do 3 caption options + 2 hero crops. Will upload assets to /marketing/launch/assets in the AM.

emily: perfect. captions should include 1) product benefit hook, 2) benchmark narrative (latency/cost wins), 3) CTA for webinar sign-up. also need 280-char version for X thread starter.

jordan: got it. Quick Q: do we want a single hero for both platforms or platform-specific images?

emily: platform-specific preferred — linkedin needs more explanatory overlay, x should be punchier.

sam: For schedule — recommend 10am PT / 1pm ET for primary post, then a 24hr reminder 10am PT next day, and a 3hr pre-show bump. Works with our paid funnel timings.

tia: Benchmarks: can we call out ~2.3x throughput vs baseline and 40% lower per-token cost on Redwood Dedicated? Need approvals from product to cite numbers.
jordan: i'll mark those as variable copy placeholders like "~2x throughput" until product confirms.
emily: yep pls placeholder. tia — can you share the benchmark one-liner options? short, social-friendly.

tia: 3 quick options:
- "Ship LLM features with 2x throughput and 40% lower per-token cost — see how in our launch webinar."
- "Cut inference cost by 40% while improving throughput — demo in next week's webinar."
- "Faster, cheaper inference: real-world benchmarks + rollout tips in our webinar."

emily: love these. we'll A/B test 1 and 3.

michael: tagging ops: please confirm UTM and destination URLs. Use utm_source=social, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_apr2024. Redirect to /webinar/launch-apr2024? We'll also add a prefilled GForm param for lead routing.

emily: yes use those UTMs. also include ?seed=seedlistX when posting to the seeded cohort so SDR can identify.

sam: SDR routing plan: seeded leads -> #sdr-inbound priority queue. Organic signups -> normal nurture. sdr-bot can post a summary to #sdr-inbound with the UTM and first 5 signups.

sdr-bot: (automated) Will post signup summary to #sdr-inbound and tag the on-call SDR. Format: "New webinar signups — campaign: launch_apr2024 — top 5: [list]"

jordan: uploaded three hero PNGs: hero_main-16x9.png, hero_x-1x1.png, hero_ln-overlay.png — in /marketing/launch/assets. Also dropped copy options as assets: captions_v1.txt.

emily: thanks jordan. can someone draft 2 engagement follow-up DMs for registrants who came from X threads? Keep them short and personalized.

sam: DM A: "Hey {{first_name}} — thanks for registering! Quick Q: what model use-case are you most interested in? Reply and I’ll share the relevant snippet from the demo."

sam: DM B: "Appreciate you signing up! If you can't make it live, we’ll send the recording + tailored resources after. Anything specific you want covered?"

emily: nice. add a comment to the SDR handoff doc: tag registrant source in the CRM as "social_x" when routing.

tia: analytics note — set up a custom event for "thread_engagement_click" to capture clicks from each X thread tweet id. helps map which caption performs.
jordan: also thinking of a 3-tweet thread: opener (hero and hook), benchmark stat (card), CTA (register). I'll draft thread copy tonight.

emily: deadline recap — EOD tomorrow: final caption decisions, assets in the folder, UTM/URL confirmed, seedlist routing doc updated, SDR DM templates in the handoff doc. If anything slips ping me directly. :thumbsup:

michael: putting the calendar post schedule in the shared sheet now. I'll sync with eng ops for the landing capacity check.

emily: thanks all. small follow-up: can someone run the accessibility check on hero images? alt text needed.
jordan: will do alt text + 2 accessibility color tweaks.

emily: perfect. closing loop — will publish final thread schedule in #marketing at 9am tomorrow. :eyes:
